options.reason: The seven binary fault columns (Pastry, Z_Scratch, K_Scatch, Stains, Dirtiness, Bumps, Other_Faults) are categorical defect outcomes describing the same plate row, so they are modeled jointly as targets; all other columns are geometric/luminosity/shape descriptors usable as features. No column is a component or recoding of these outcomes and there is no row key or chronological ordering.
options.title: multilabel
